faq.heading: Common questions

faq.items.question: How much does it cost?
faq.items.answer: It depends on scope. We give fixed quotes after an initial conversation so there are no surprises.

faq.items.question: How long does a typical project take?
faq.items.answer: Most projects run two to six weeks. We will give you a timeline before we start.

faq.items.question: Do you offer ongoing support?
faq.items.answer: Yes. Monthly plans start from a low flat rate and you can cancel any time.

faq.items.question: What if I am not happy with the result?
faq.items.answer: We offer a thirty-day money-back guarantee on all new projects.
